## Summary

Describe the visible change to a rendered document and why it belongs in this
theme rather than in a consuming project.

## Verification

- [ ] `pytest tests/ -q` passes
- [ ] `scripts/test.sh` builds both examples
- [ ] Layout changes are checked against the LaTeX reference (`lmedoc.cls`), and any deliberate deviation is stated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased
- [ ] Fixtures and examples contain no real personal data, and no institution assets beyond those already documented in `assets/LOGO-PROVENANCE.md`
